title: Arithmetic constraint $\chi(A)=-6$ as a topological forcing term
html: Mathematical novelty. The proof combines four conditional geometric inputs (Kummer tower survival, persistent obstruction, core-Levi bounding, BKM divergence) into a single deterministic criterion. It bypasses brute-force PDE estimates, using the arithmetic constraint \chi(A)=-6 as a global topological forcing term that dictates finite-time blowup through categorical mechanics alone.
